name: Masaru: Ashita no Yukinojou 2
original_name: 勝　あしたの雪之丞２
source:
Kubo Masaru finally has recovered from the coma, and at present is attending Ryouzuki school. However, due to his insufficient attendance, he has to repeat a year, is moved from the specially selected sports class to a general education class and additionally got restricted from practicing box. Thus Masaru is frustrated of being unable to continue his only hobby and is completely burning out inside because he doesn't know what to do next in his new reality.

Just what sort of destiny such a Masaru could end up with?
translation:
久保胜终于从昏迷中苏醒，目前正在陵月学园就读。然而由于出勤不足，他不得不留级，还从体育特招生班被调入普通班，并被禁止继续练习拳击。无法延续自己唯一的爱好，让胜倍感沮丧。面对全新的现实，他不知道下一步该做什么，心中也几乎燃烧殆尽。

这样的胜，最终究竟会走向怎样的命运？
